title: AC1027 standalone ENTITIES ATTDEF LTYPE XDATA target binding

scope.source: Runtime-generated original ASCII and binary DXF records; no repository drawing fixture was added.
scope.cross_product: One model-space ENTITIES ATTDEF code-1005 target across all four source/output encoding pairs.

xdata.provider: source-bound simple LTYPE EditDash and APPID MLINE_LTYPE_XDATA

proof.source: Candidate indexing requires the physical ATTDEF span and model-space owner, the paired AttdefSource/addAttDef delivery events with exact type/handle/owner identity, a unique exact DRW_Attdef model equal to its captured profile, and attdefPairReady() for the standalone source context. The standalone source/profile/origin gate remains independent; raw/typed pointer identity is not assumed.
proof.output: All four ASCII/binary input/output combinations verify emitted ATTDEF identity, ENTITIES section and remapped model-space owner, selected physical text/tag/prompt/point/height/flag fields, ordered LTYPE code-1005 remapping, and fresh typed ATTDEF/LTYPE readback.
proof.failure_retry: Each encoding pair removes the target and verifies destination preservation followed by same-adapter retry. An additional late handle mutation refuses with destination preservation and succeeds after restoring the target identity.

limits: This qualifies one AC1027 standalone ENTITIES ATTDEF source profile only. Other ATTDEF field/subclass/version profiles and multiple-target combinations remain unqualified.
The selected transport proof does not establish ATTRIB/INSERT attribute association, ATTDEF editing support, recursive dependency closure, complete-document conversion, or independent CAD semantics.
P2 remains open for other code-1005 target types, mixed target sets and broader source/output profiles.
next: Select the next current P2 target only after reproducing a concrete parser, source-binding or emitted-output gap; retain the existing ATTDEF source/profile gate and avoid adding unqualified type/profile coverage.
